label: gamma-glutamyltransferase activity
definition: A phenotype in which a microorganism exhibits gamma-glutamyltransferase/glutathione-hydrolase activity, processing glutathione, glutathione-S-conjugates, or other N-terminal L-gamma-glutamyl substrates through a gamma-glutamyl-enzyme intermediate.
observations: Follow-up from the physiology diagnostic-enzyme gap sweep; absent from METPO and TraitMech after a gamma-glutamyltransferase duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
